THE central controversy of this match. At 50:05, Bret Hart threw Steve Austin out of the ring -- but the referees were distracted by a Mankind/Terry Funk brawl outside the ring and didn't see it. Austin snuck back in undetected, eliminated Undertaker and Vader (who were brawling on the ropes), then eliminated Bret Hart from behind to 'win' the match.
